messages.subject: modifying default listings style associated with render_listings()?
parts:
I've located Sweavel.sty and modified it but the style remains the
same.

How do we change the default listings style associated with
render_listings()?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] modifying default listings style associated with render_listings()?
parts:
What does system('kpsewhich Sweavel.sty') tell you? If it can find
your own version of Sweavel.sty, knitr will not use the version in
knitr.
